message.content:
I’m not able to check real‑time inventory directly, but you can quickly confirm the availability of the shirt in size L and 4L by:

1. Visiting the product page on our website and selecting the sizes from the drop‑down menu.  
2. Checking the “In Stock” indicator next to each size.  
3. If it’s out of stock, you can add it to your wishlist or sign up for a restock notification.

If you’d like, I can also help you place an order or set up a notification for when those sizes become available. Just let me know!
